$comment: Health-check matrix plan (utils/healthMatrix.js). One entry per check id (the @HC### tag on a scenario in features/monitoring/healthCheck.feature). applies: apps the check is relevant to (others = NA). backed: apps with an automated test (applies but not backed = Skip). policy: 'excluded' = NA everywhere (unsafe to run unattended on prod, e.g. places an order); 'heartbeat' = HB (covered by the 2-hourly heartbeat instead).
